title: Jubilees 4 — Adam to Noah, the murder of Abel, and Enoch the first scribe

paragraphs.text: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ሣልስ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ቅንአ፡ ቃየል፡ ለአቤል፡ እኁሁ፡ እስመ፡ ይሰዐር፡ እግዚእ፡ ላዕለ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ አቤል፡ ወላዕለ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ቃየል፡ ኢተሰዐረ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-fəṣṣāmē qadāmāwi sabuʿ śāləs ʾiyobēləwu qənʾa Qāyāl la-ʾAbēl ʾəḫuhu ʾəsma yəssaʿar ʾəgziʾ lāʿla maśwāʿta ʾAbēl wa-lāʿla maśwāʿta Qāyāl ʾi-tassaʿara

i18n.en: And at the end of the first week of the third jubilee, Cain envied Abel his brother, because the Lord accepted the sacrifice of Abel and did not accept the sacrifice of Cain.

paragraphs.text: ወቀተሎ፡ በገዳም፡ ወዜንወት፡ ደሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ለእግዚእ፡ ለቤዛ፡ ቅትለቱ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-qatalo ba-gadām wa-zēnnawat damu lāʿla mədr la-ʾəgziʾ la-bēzā qətlatu

i18n.en: And he killed him in the field; and his blood cried out from the ground to the Lord, claiming vengeance for his slaying.

paragraphs.text: ወረገሞ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለቃየል፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ደም፡ ዘከውን፡ ቅቱለ፡ ወወሀቦ፡ ኪያሁ፡ በምድር፡ ዘይትገነይ፡ ወይውዕል፡ ይብሉ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ragagamo ʾəgziʾ la-Qāyāl ʾəm-nə mədr ʾəm-nə dam zakon qətula wa-wahabō kiyāhu ba-mədr za-yətgannay wa-yəwʿəl yəblu lāʿlēhu mədr

i18n.en: And the Lord cursed Cain from the ground because of the blood which was shed; and he gave him over to the earth to wander and groan upon it, while the earth itself cried out against him.

paragraphs.text: ወበእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ርግምት፡ ለዘ፡ ይዘብጥ፡ ካልኦ፡ በዕልው፡ ወይብሉ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ርእዩ፡ ወእለ፡ ሰምዑ፡ አሜን፡ ወብእሲ፡ ዘርእየ፡ ወኢዜነወ፡ ይኩን፡ ርጉመ፡ ከማሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾənta zəntu ṣəḥuf wəsta ṣəlāta samāy rəgəmət la-za yəzabbəṭ kāləʾo ba-ʿəlw wa-yəblu kwəlomu ʾəlla rəʾəyu wa-ʾəlla samʿu ʾāmēn wa-bəʾəsi za-rəʾəya wa-ʾi-zēnnawa yəkun rəgguma kamāhu

i18n.en: And on account of this it is written on the heavenly tablets: Cursed is one who strikes his neighbor treacherously, and let all who have seen and heard say Amen; and the man who has seen and has not told it, let him be cursed like him.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ አንበረ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለቃየል፡ ትእምርተ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይቅትሎ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘረከቦ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu ʾanbara lottu la-Qāyāl təʾəmərta kama ʾi-yəqtəlo kwəlu zarakabō

i18n.en: On account of this he set a sign upon Cain, that no one who found him should kill him.

paragraphs.text: ויהיו אדם ואשתו מתאבלים על הבל ארבעים שנה ובשנה הרביעית של השבוע השלישי של היובל השלישי שמח אדם וידע את אשתו ותלד לו בן ויקרא את שמו שת כי אמר הקים לנו אלהים זרע אחר תחת הבל כי הרגו קין
paragraphs.translit: wa-yihyū ʾĀdām wə-ʾištō mit-ʾabbəlīm ʿal Hebel ʾarbāʿīm šānāh ū-ba-šānāh hā-rəbīʿīt šel ha-šābūaʿ ha-šəlīšī šel ha-yōbēl ha-šəlīšī śāmaḥ ʾĀdām wa-yēdaʿ ʾet ʾištō wa-tēled lō bēn wa-yiqrāʾ ʾet šəmō Šēt kī ʾāmar hēqīm lā-nū ʾĕlōhīm zeraʿ ʾaḥēr taḥat Hebel kī hărāḡō Qayin

i18n.en: And Adam and his wife mourned for Abel forty years; and in the fourth year of the third week of the third jubilee, Adam was comforted and knew his wife, and she bore him a son. And he called his name Seth, for he said: God has appointed for us another seed upon the earth in place of Abel, because Cain killed him.

paragraphs.text: ובשבוע החמישי של היובל החמישי הוליד את חנוך לאחיו וקרא את שמו אנוש כי אז החל בני האדם לקרוא בשם השם
paragraphs.translit: ū-ba-šābūaʿ ha-ḥămīšī šel ha-yōbēl ha-ḥămīšī hōlīd ʾet Ḥănōk lə-ʾāḥīw wə-qārāʾ ʾet šəmō ʾĔnōš kī ʾāz hēḥēl bənē hā-ʾādām li-qrōʾ bə-šēm ha-šēm

i18n.en: And in the fifth week of the fifth jubilee he begot Enosh; and he called his name Enosh, for it was then that the sons of men began to call upon the name of the Lord.

paragraphs.text: ወወለደ፡ ቃየናንሰ፡ ለማላልኤል፡ ወወለደ፡ ማላልኤልሰ፡ ለያሬድ፡ ወወለደ፡ ያሬድሰ፡ ለሄኖክ፡ በሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዐሥር፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-walada Qāyenānsa la-Malālʾel wa-walada Malālʾelsa la-Yāred wa-walada Yāredsa la-Henok ba-śāləs sabuʿ ba-ʿaśr ʾiyobēləwu

i18n.en: And Kenan begot Mahalalel, and Mahalalel begot Jared, and Jared begot Enoch, in the third week of the tenth jubilee.

paragraphs.text: ወነሥአ፡ ቃየናን፡ ለሙአሌት፡ እኅቶ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በዓመት፡ ሣልስ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ማላልኤል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-naśʾa Qāyenān la-Muʾalēt ʾəḫto la-rəʾəsu bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-ʿāmat śāləs la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu wa-samayō səmō Malālʾel

i18n.en: And Kenan took Mualeleth his sister as wife for himself, and she bore him a son in the third year of this jubilee; and he called his name Mahalalel.

paragraphs.text: ወማላልኤልሰ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ዲናህ፡ ወለተ፡ ባራኬል፡ እኅተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በሳምን፡ ሣልስ፡ በሰዱስ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሳምን፡ ሳድስ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ያሬድ፡ እስመ፡ በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ወረዱ፡ መላእክተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እለ፡ ይሰመዩ፡ ትጉሃን፡ ከመ፡ ይምሀርዎሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ፍትሐ፡ ወርትዐ፡ ዲበ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-Malālʾelsa naśʾa lottu Dināhə walatta Bārākēl ʾəḫta ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita ba-sāmən śāləs ba-sadus ʾiyobēləwu wa-waladat lottu walda ba-sāmən sādəsə ba-ʿāmat qadāmāwi la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu wa-samayō səmō Yāred ʾəsma ba-mawāʿəlihu waradu malāʾəkta ʾəgziʾ lāʿla mədr ʾəlla yəssammayu Təguhānə kama yəmharəwomu la-daqiqa sabʾ wa-kama yəgbaru fətḥa wa-rətʿa diba mədr

i18n.en: And Mahalalel took as wife for himself Dinah, daughter of Barakiel, daughter of his father's brother, in the third week of the sixth jubilee; and she bore him a son in the sixth week, in the first year of this jubilee. And he called his name Jared, because in his days the angels of the Lord descended upon the earth — those who are called Watchers — that they might instruct the sons of men, and that they might do judgment and righteousness upon the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወባራካ፡ ወለተ፡ ራሱኤል፡ እኅተ፡ አቡሁ፡ ሎቱ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሄኖክ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-Bārāka walatta Rāsuʾēl ʾəḫta ʾabbuhu lottu bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-śāləs sabuʿ ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat wa-samayō səmō Henok

i18n.en: And Jared took as wife for himself Baraka, daughter of Rasuel, the daughter of his father's brother; and she bore him a son in the third week, in the fourth year, and he called his name Enoch.

paragraphs.text: ወውእቱ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ እምነ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘተወልደ፡ ዘተምህረ፡ ጽሕፈተ፡ ወአእምሮተ፡ ወጥበበ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wəʾtu qadāmāwi ʾəm-nə daqiqa sabʾ za-wəsta mədr za-tawalda za-tamhəra ṣəḥfata wa-ʾaʾmərota wa-ṭəbaba

i18n.en: And he was the first among the sons of men who were born upon the earth to learn writing and knowledge and wisdom.

paragraphs.text: ויכתוב את אתות השמים כסדר חדשיהם בספר למען ידעו בני האדם זמני השנים כסדרם בחדשיהם
paragraphs.translit: wa-yiktōb ʾet ʾōtōt ha-šāmayim kə-sēder ḥodšēhem ba-sēper lə-maʿan yēdəʿū bənē hā-ʾādām zəmannē ha-šānīm kə-sidrām bə-ḥodšēhem

i18n.en: And he wrote down the signs of the heavens, according to the order of their months, in a book, so that the sons of men might know the seasons of the years according to their order, by their respective months.

paragraphs.text: ויהי הראשון אשר כתב עדות ויעד את בני האדם בדורות הארץ והוגד לו את שבועות היובלים בעשר ועשר וירא את חדשי הימים ויספרם ויקרא בשמותם
paragraphs.translit: wa-yhī hā-rīʾšōn ʾăšer kātab ʿēdūt wa-yāʿad ʾet bənē hā-ʾādām bə-dōrōt hā-ʾāreṣ wə-hūggad lō ʾet šəbūʿōt ha-yōbəlīm bə-ʿeśer wā-ʿeśer wa-yarʾ ʾet ḥodšē ha-yāmīm wa-yispərēm wa-yiqrāʾ bi-šmōtām

i18n.en: And he was the first to write a testimony, and he testified to the sons of men among the generations of the earth. And he was shown the weeks of the jubilees, in tens upon tens; and he saw the months of the days, and counted them, and called them by their names.

paragraphs.text: ወሤመ፡ ዘመነ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለዓመታት፡ በምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ሤመ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-śēma zamana qadāmāwi la-ʿāmatāt ba-məsla malāʾəkta samāy śēma

i18n.en: And he ordained the first reckoning of the years, ordaining it together with the angels of heaven.

notes.official: The giants are explicitly identified as offspring of the Watchers (bidirectional to v2.66.0 Watchers entry); the Jubilees-distinctive detail at 4:15 is that the Watchers' original mission was BENEVOLENT, only later corrupted by taking human wives.

paragraphs.text: ויקח לו את עדני בת דניאל בת אחי אביו לאשה בשבוע הרביעי של היובל הזה בשנה הרביעית ותלד לו בן בשנה הרביעית של היובל הזה ויקרא את שמו מתושלח
paragraphs.translit: wa-yiqqaḥ lō ʾet ʿEdnī bat Dānīʾēl bat ʾăḥī ʾābīw lə-ʾiššāh ba-šābūaʿ hā-rəbīʿī šel ha-yōbēl ha-zeh ba-šānāh hā-rəbīʿīt wa-tēled lō bēn ba-šānāh hā-rəbīʿīt šel ha-yōbēl ha-zeh wa-yiqrāʾ ʾet šəmō Mətūšelaḥ

i18n.en: And he took as his wife Edni, daughter of Daniel, the daughter of his father's brother, in the fourth week of this jubilee, in the fourth year; and she bore him a son in the fourth year of this jubilee, and he called his name Methuselah.

paragraphs.text: ወሀለወ፡ ምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ስድስተ፡ ኢዮቤልዋተ፡ ዓመታት፡ ወአርአይዎ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ወዘውስተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ፀሐይ፡ ወጸሐፈ፡ ኵሎ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-hallawa məsla malāʾəkta ʾəgziʾ sədəsta ʾiyobēləwāta ʿāmatāt wa-ʾarʾayəwo kwəlo zawəsta mədr wa-zawəsta samāy kwənnānē ḍaḥay wa-ṣaḥafa kwəlo

i18n.en: And he was with the angels of the Lord for six jubilees of years, and they showed him everything that is on the earth and in the heavens, the rule of the sun; and he wrote down all things.

notes.official: Jub 4:17 is the EARLIEST EXTANT TEXT establishing Enoch as the first to learn writing + the celestial-scribe of the signs of heaven. Foundational text for the Enoch-as-celestial-scribe + Enoch-Metatron tradition.

paragraphs.text: ወወጥረ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ አውራኂሆሙ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፍ፡ ከመ፡ ያእምሩ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ጊዜ፡ ዓመታት፡ በከመ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ በበ፡ አውራኂሆሙ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-waṭra təʾəmərta samāy ba-kama śərʿata ʾawrāḫihomu wəsta maṣḥaf kama yāʾmərru daqiqa sabʾ gizē ʿāmatāt ba-kama śərʿatomu baba ʾawrāḫihomu

i18n.en: And he wrote down the signs of the heavens, according to the order of their months, in a book, so that the sons of men might know the seasons of the years, according to their order, by their respective months.

paragraphs.text: ውእቱ፡ ጸሐፈ፡ ስምዐ፡ ወሤሞ፡ ለስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ትውልዶሙ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኩናኔ፡ መላእክት፡ እለ፡ አበሱ፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ አንስት፡ እስመ፡ ቀዳሚ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ኀደጉ፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ቀዳማዌ፡ ወዘመው፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wəʾtu ṣaḥafa səmʿa wa-śēmo la-səmʿ lāʿla mədr lāʿla kwəlomu daqiqa sabʾ wa-lāʿla təwlədomu wa-ʾəmənna kwənnānē malāʾəkt ʾəlla ʾabasu məsla daqiqa ʾanəst ʾəsma qadāmi ʾəmuntu ḫadagu śərʿatomu qadāmāwē wa-zammawu məsla daqiqa mədr

i18n.en: He wrote down a testimony and set it for a witness upon the earth, against all the sons of men and against their generations — and concerning the judgment of the angels who sinned with the daughters of men; for these had left their first order and committed fornication with the daughters of the earth.

paragraphs.text: ወምስለ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ኮነ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ስድስተ፡ ኢዮቤልዋተ፡ ዓመት፡ ወአንበረ፡ ስምዓ፡ በውስተ፡ መጽሐፋት፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ግብረ፡ ትውልድ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኩናኔ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-məsla kiyāhu kona Henok sədəsta ʾiyobēləwāta ʿāmat wa-ʾanbara səmʿa ba-wəsta maṣḥafāt lāʿla kwəlomu gəbra təwlədə ʾəska ʿəlata kwənnānē

i18n.en: And Enoch remained with them for six jubilees of years, and he set down the testimony in books concerning all the works of the generations, until the day of judgment.

paragraphs.text: ወአዕረገ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ቀዳማዌ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ዕፀ፡ ሕይወት፡ ዘውስተ፡ ቤተ፡ መቅደስ፡ ኬደ፡ ሰማይ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga maśwāʿta qadāmāwē lāʿla mədr ʿəḍa ḥəywat zawəsta bēta maqdas kēda samāy

i18n.en: And he offered up the first sacrifice upon the earth — the wood of the tree of life that is in the sanctuary, the heights of heaven.

paragraphs.text: ወሤሞ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡ ለትትዐውቅ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ እለ፡ ይዜምዉ፡ ወይትዐደው፡ ሥርዐቶሙ፡ ቀዳማዌ፡ ወከመ፡ ይምጻእ፡ ድልወት፡ ለቅቱል፡ ወዘይዜምዉ፡ ምስለ፡ አንስት፡ ይትኰነኑ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-śēmo ʾəgziʾ la-səmʿ lāʿla kwəlu təwlədə la-tətʿawwəq kwənnānē lāʿla kwəlomu ʾəlla yəzēmmuwə wa-yətʿaddawə śərʿatomu qadāmāwē wa-kama yəmṣāʾ dəlwat la-qətul wa-zayəzēmmuwə məsla ʾanəst yətkwannanu

i18n.en: And the Lord set him as a witness over all generations, that the judgment might be made known upon all who transgress their first order and commit fornication with women, that recompense might come upon the slayer, and that all who fornicate with women might be judged.

notes.official: Enoch writes the indictment of the Watchers — foundational text for the Enoch-as-witness-against-the-Watchers tradition (cf. 1 En 13).

paragraphs.text: ወነሥአት፡ ኪያሁ፡ እምነ፡ ማእከለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወወሰድናሁ፡ ውስተ፡ ገነተ፡ ኤዶም፡ ለክብር፡ ወለስብሐት፡ ወናሁ፡ ሀሎ፡ በህየ፡ ይጽሕፍ፡ ኩናኔ፡ ወሥርዐተ፡ ዓለም፡ ወኵሎ፡ እከያተ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-naśʾat kiyāhu ʾəm-nə māʾkala daqiqa sabʾ wa-wasadnāhu wəsta ganata ʾEdom la-kəbər wa-la-səbḥat wa-nāhu hallo ba-həya yəṣəḥəf kwənnānē wa-śərʿata ʿālam wa-kwəlo ʾəkayāta daqiqa sabʾ

i18n.en: And he was taken from among the sons of men, and we brought him into the garden of Eden for glory and honor; and behold, he is there writing down the judgment and the ordinance of the ages, and all the wickedness of the sons of men.

notes.official: Enoch taken into Eden — bidirectional to 1 En 32 (tree of wisdom east of paradise) + 2 En 8 (Eden as Enoch's intermediate dwelling).

paragraphs.text: ወበእንቲአሁ፡ አምጻእ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድረ፡ ኤዶም፡ እስመ፡ በህየ፡ ተቀብአ፡ ወውእቱ፡ ትእምርት፡ ለርትዕ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡ ዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ይኰንን፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ትውልድ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ ኩናኔ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-ʾəntiʾahu ʾamṣāʾ māya ʾāyəḫ lāʿla kwəlu mədra ʾEdom ʾəsma ba-həya taqabʾa wa-wəʾtu təʾəmərt la-rətʿ la-kwəlu təwlədə ʿālam kama yəkwannən kwəlo gəbra təwlədə ʾəska ʿəlata kwənnānē

i18n.en: And on account of him the waters of the flood did not come upon all the land of Eden, because he was set there as a sign and to bear witness against all the generations of the world, that he should give an account of all the works of every generation until the day of judgment.

paragraphs.text: ወአዕረገ፡ ዕጣነ፡ ቅዱሰ፡ ዘሠናይ፡ መዓዛ፡ በዘይትከበር፡ እምቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ በደብር፡ ጽድቅ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga ʿəṭāna qəddusa zaśannāya maʿāzā ba-zayətkabbar ʾəm-qədma ʾəgziʾ ba-dabra ṣədq

i18n.en: And he offered up a holy incense, a sweet savor, that is acceptable before the Lord on the mountain of righteousness.

paragraphs.text: እስመ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ብሔራት፡ ቅዱሳት፡ ለእግዚእ፡ ገነት፡ ኤዶም፡ ወደብር፡ ምሥራቅ፡ ወዝንቱ፡ ደብር፡ ዘሀለውክሙ፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ዮም፡ ደብር፡ ሲና፡ ወደብር፡ ጽዮን፡ ይቄድስ፡ በፍጥረት፡ ሐዲስ፡ ለቅድሳተ፡ ምድር፡ በእንተዝ፡ ትትቄደስ፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ርኵስ፡ በትውልደ፡ ዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: ʾəsma ʾarbāʿtu bəḥērāt qəddusāt la-ʾəgziʾ ganat ʾEdom wa-dabra məśrāq wa-zəntu dabr za-hallawkəmu lāʿlēhu yom dabr Sina wa-dabra Ṣəyon yəqeddəs ba-fəṭrat ḥaddis la-qədsāta mədr ba-ʾəntazə tətqeddas mədr ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu rəkws ba-təwlədə ʿālam

i18n.en: For there are four holy places of the Lord: the garden of Eden, and the mountain of the east, and this mountain on which you stand today, Mount Sinai, and Mount Zion — which shall be sanctified in the new creation for the sanctification of the earth. Through it the earth shall be sanctified from all sin and from all uncleanness throughout the generations of the world.

paragraphs.text: ወበሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፪፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ማቱሳላ፡ ብእሲተ፡ እዳና፡ ወለተ፡ አዙራ፡ ወለተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ላሜክ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-śāləs sabuʿ ʾiyobēləwu za-2 naśʾa lottu Mātusālā bəʾəsita ʾEdānā walatta ʾAzurā walatta ʾəḫuhu la-ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat la-zəntu sabuʿ wa-waladat lottu walda wa-samayō səmō Lāmek

i18n.en: And in the third week of the twelfth jubilee Methuselah took as wife Edna, daughter of Azrial, the daughter of his father's brother. In the fourth year of this week she bore him a son, and he called his name Lamech.

paragraphs.text: ወበሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፫፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ላሜክ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ቤትኖስ፡ ወለተ፡ ባራኬል፡ ወለተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ በዓመት፡ ኃምስ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወይቤ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ያሳርሐነ፡ እምነ፡ ግብር፡ ወእምነ፡ ድካመ፡ እደዊነ፡ ወእምነ፡ ምድር፡ እንተ፡ ረገማ፡ እግዚእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-śāləs sabuʿ ʾiyobēləwu za-3 naśʾa lottu Lāmek bəʾəsita Bētənos walatta Bārākēl walatta ʾəḫuhu la-ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita wa-waladat lottu walda ba-zəntu sabuʿ ba-ʿāmat ḫāməs wa-samayō səmō Noḫ wa-yəbē zəntu yāsārəḥana ʾəm-nə gəbər wa-ʾəm-nə dəkāma ʾədawina wa-ʾəm-nə mədr ʾənta ragamā ʾəgziʾ

i18n.en: And in the third week of the thirteenth jubilee Lamech took as wife Betenos, daughter of Barakiel, the daughter of his father's brother; and she bore him a son in this week, in the fifth year, and he called his name Noah, saying: This one shall comfort us from our labor and from the toil of our hands, and from the ground which the Lord has cursed.

paragraphs.text: ובסוף תשע מאות שלשים שנה תשעה עשר יובלים שבעה שבועים ושתי שנים בו ביובל מת אדם וקברו אותו כל בניו בארץ בריאתו והוא היה ראשון נקבר בארץ
paragraphs.translit: ū-bə-sōp təšaʿ mēʾōt šəlōšīm šānāh tišʿāh ʿāśār yōbəlīm šibʿāh šābūʿīm ū-šətē šānīm bō ba-yōbēl mēt ʾĀdām wa-yiqbərū ʾōtō kol bānāyw bə-ʾereṣ bərīʾātō wə-hūʾ hāyāh rīʾšōn niqbar bā-ʾāreṣ

i18n.en: And at the end of nine hundred and thirty years — nineteen jubilees, seven weeks, and two years — in this jubilee Adam died, and all his sons buried him in the land of his creation. And he was the first to be buried in the earth.

paragraphs.text: וחסר משבעים שנה משבעת מאות שנה כי שבעת מאות שנה הם יום אחד בעדות השמים ועל כן כתב על העץ אשר ביום אכלך ממנו תמות לכך לא השלים את שנות היום ההוא כי בו מת
paragraphs.translit: wə-ḥāsēr mi-šibʿīm šānāh mi-šibʿat mēʾōt šānāh kī šibʿat mēʾōt šānāh hēm yōm ʾeḥād bə-ʿēdūt ha-šāmayim wə-ʿal kēn kātab ʿal hā-ʿēṣ ʾăšer bə-yōm ʾākəlkā mim-mennū tāmūt lā-kēn lōʾ hišlīm ʾet šənōt ha-yōm ha-hūʾ kī bō mēt

i18n.en: And he lacked seventy years of a thousand years, for a thousand years are as one day in the testimony of the heavens; and therefore it was written concerning the tree of knowledge, 'In the day that you eat of it you shall die.' Therefore he did not complete the years of that day, for he died within it.

paragraphs.text: ובסוף היובל הזה הוכה קין באבן באבן ויהי כי קין הרג להבל באבן ובאבן נכה הרג במשפט צדק
paragraphs.translit: ū-bə-sōp ha-yōbēl ha-zeh hukkāh Qayin bā-ʾeben bā-ʾeben wa-yhī kī Qayin hāraḡ lə-Hebel bā-ʾeben ū-bā-ʾeben nukkāh hāraḡ bə-mišpaṭ ṣedeq

i18n.en: And at the end of this jubilee Cain was killed by a stone — by a stone; for as Cain had killed Abel with a stone, so by a stone was he killed in righteous judgment, his house falling upon him.

paragraphs.text: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ በመጠን፡ ዘመነኔ፡ ኪያሁ፡ ይትመነን፡ ወከመ፡ ቅትለቱ፡ ይትቀተል፡ ወበልኪቱ፡ ይሰፈር፡ ላዕሌሁ፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy ba-maṭan zamannāyē kiyāhu yətmannan wa-kama qətlatu yətqattal wa-ba-ləkitu yəssaffar lāʿlēhu

i18n.en: On account of this it is ordained on the heavenly tablets: with the instrument with which a man has killed his neighbor, with the same shall he be killed; and after the manner of his wounding, even so shall it be measured back to him.

notes.official: Cain's death-by-stone is explicitly written on the heavenly tablets as the measure-for-measure principle (kill with stone — die by stone). Bidirectional to rabbinic mishnaic principle (b. Sanhedrin 76a).

paragraphs.text: ወበሣልስ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ካልእ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ነሥአ፡ ሎቱ፡ ኖኅ፡ ብእሲተ፡ ስማ፡ ኤምዛራ፡ ወለተ፡ ራኬኤል፡ ወለተ፡ እኁሁ፡ ለአቡሁ፡ ብእሲተ፡ በዓመት፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ለሰቡዕ፡ ኃምስ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ወወለደት፡ ሎቱ፡ ወልደ፡ በሣልስ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ሴም፡ ወበራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ካልአ፡ ሰመዮ፡ ሐም፡ ወበኃምስ፡ ዓመት፡ ካልአ፡ ይአፌት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-śāləs sabuʿ kāləʾ ʾiyobēləwu naśʾa lottu Noḫ bəʾəsita səmā ʾEmzārā walatta Rākēʾēl walatta ʾəḫuhu la-ʾabbuhu bəʾəsita ba-ʿāmat qadāmāwi la-sabuʿ ḫāməs la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu wa-waladat lottu walda ba-śāləs ʿāmat la-zəntu sabuʿ wa-samayō səmō Sēm wa-ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat kāləʾa samayō Ḥam wa-ba-ḫāməs ʿāmat kāləʾa Yāfet

i18n.en: And in the third week of the fifteenth jubilee Noah took as wife Emzara, daughter of Rakeel, the daughter of his father's brother, in the first year of the fifth week of this jubilee; and she bore him a son in the third year of this week, and he called his name Shem; and in the fourth year she bore him another, and he called his name Ham; and in the fifth year another, and he called him Japheth.
